_comment: CompoundingPerf — toggle each optimization independently. Debug log off by default. Easiest: in game, F12 → Tushonka Cleaner — changes there apply instantly and are saved back into this file. Editing this file by hand needs a server restart.
_MasterEnabled_note: One-switch A/B toggle for benchmarking: false installs NO patches at all (server + client) regardless of the flags below. The FrameStats recorder stays on either way, so with/without comparisons are a single flip apart. Changing this needs a server restart (it decides whether the patches are installed at all), so it is not in the F12 menu. Everything else can be changed live from F12.
_retired: Removed because SPT 4.1 does the job itself: S1, S2, S6, S7, S10. Removed in 1.1.0 after measuring on 4.1.6: S8, S11, S13, S15, S16. The site lists the numbers. Leaving their old keys in this file is harmless; they are ignored.

Server._FastCompression_note: Vanilla zlib-compresses every response at SmallestSize (slowest). Measured on 4.1.6 over nine main endpoints: SmallestSize 636 ms / 4.9 MB, Optimal 440 ms / 4.9 MB, Fastest 351 ms / 7.8 MB. Optimal is the default: same size, so remote FIKA players lose nothing.
Server._IsolatedBotRandomisation_note: Fixes a vanilla bug: night-raid equipment modifiers are written into SHARED bot config — they compound per generated bot, persist across raids until restart, and race across parallel bot generation. Still present in 4.1.5. With this on, every bot gets a private copy and the modifier applies exactly once.

Client._FrameStats_note: Dev benchmark builds only (compiled with -p:Bench=true). Release builds contain no frame recorder and ignore this section entirely. In bench builds: per-raid stats line (map / population / avg / 1% low / 0.1% low / hitches / worst spike) appended to SPT/user/logs/CompoundingPerf-framestats.jsonl on raid end. Not gated by MasterEnabled, so it measures both sides of an A/B run.

_Debug_note: NEW in 2.1. Verification log, off by default: user/logs/CompoundingPerf/CompoundingPerf-debug-<date>-<time>.log (one file per server start, KeepFiles newest kept). Startup self-check (did each patch land), every forced collect S8/S15 touched, raid start/end timing, per-raid memory/GC summary, slowest endpoints, bot generation timing, and a periodic summary every SummaryIntervalMinutes (0 = off). SlowRequestMs: requests at least this slow are listed one by one. Switch it from F12 (instant) or here (restart). Replaces the old Telemetry section, which 2.0 never actually wired up.
